-- BEGIN LOBO BRIGHT ZONES R1
-- Coordinates and line widths are measured in tabletop inches.
local loboZonePalette={
 {name='Red',rgb={1,0,0},hex='#FF0000FF'},
 {name='Orange',rgb={1,.45,0},hex='#FF7300FF'},
 {name='Yellow',rgb={1,1,0},hex='#FFFF00FF'},
 {name='Green',rgb={0,1,0},hex='#00FF00FF'},
 {name='Blue',rgb={.10,.35,1},hex='#1A59FFFF'},
 {name='Indigo',rgb={.50,.20,1},hex='#8033FFFF'},
 {name='Violet',rgb={.90,.08,1},hex='#E614FFFF'}
}
local function loboZoneIndex(n,default)
 return type(n)=='number' and n==math.floor(n) and n>=1 and n<=7 and n or default
end
local function loboZoneVector(p)return Vector(p.x or p[1],p.y or p[2],p.z or p[3])end
local function loboInk(target,out,points,kind)
 if not target or target.isDestroyed() or #points<2 then return end
 kind=kind or 'deployment'
 local scale=target.getScale();local width=math.max(math.abs(scale.x),math.abs(scale.z),.000001)
 local function stroke(path)
  out[#out+1]={points=path,color={.015,.015,.015},thickness=.15/width,loboZoneKind=kind,loboZoneEdge=true}
  out[#out+1]={points=path,color={1,0,0},thickness=.10/width,loboZoneKind=kind,loboZoneEdge=false}
 end
 if kind~='exclusion' then stroke(points);return end
 local step,length=.50,.12
 local nextDot,distance=step*.5,0
 for i=2,#points do
  local a,b=loboZoneVector(points[i-1]),loboZoneVector(points[i])
  local aw,bw=target.positionToWorld(a),target.positionToWorld(b)
  local span=math.sqrt((bw.x-aw.x)^2+(bw.z-aw.z)^2)
  while span>0 and nextDot<=distance+span do
   local t0=math.max(0,(nextDot-distance-length/2)/span)
   local t1=math.min(1,(nextDot-distance+length/2)/span)
   stroke({{a.x+(b.x-a.x)*t0,a.y+(b.y-a.y)*t0,a.z+(b.z-a.z)*t0},
           {a.x+(b.x-a.x)*t1,a.y+(b.y-a.y)*t1,a.z+(b.z-a.z)*t1}})
   nextDot=nextDot+step
  end
  distance=distance+span
 end
end
-- One generation per MAT, shared by every contributing script. Late jobs cannot
-- restore old guides after Off, another selection, a clear, or a color change.
local function loboZoneWrite(target,source)
 if not target or target.isDestroyed() then return end
 local combined={}
 for _,line in ipairs(source or {})do if not line.loboStandardGuide then combined[#combined+1]=line end end
 for _,line in ipairs(target.getTable('LoboStandardGuides')or{})do combined[#combined+1]=line end
 source=combined
 target.setTable('LoboZoneSourceR1',source or {})
 local generation=(target.getVar('LoboZoneGenerationR1') or 0)+1
 target.setVar('LoboZoneGenerationR1',generation)
 local colors=target.getTable('LoboZoneColorsR1') or {}
 local result,tasks,cache={},{},{}
 local bounds=target.getBounds()
 local floor=bounds.center.y+bounds.size.y/2
 local tags={};for _,tag in ipairs(target.getTags() or {})do if tag:sub(1,8)=='LoboMap:' then tags[tag]=true end end
 local function terrain(o)
  if not o or o.isDestroyed() then return false end
  if o==target then return true end
  if o.hasTag('mission') or o.hasTag('controller') or o.hasTag('LoboBackgroundController') then return false end
  for tag in pairs(tags)do if o.hasTag(tag) then return true end end
  return false
 end
 for _,line in ipairs(source or {})do
  local kind=line.loboZoneKind
  if not kind then result[#result+1]=line
  else
   local rgb=kind=='scoring' and {.92,.94,1} or loboZonePalette[loboZoneIndex(colors[kind],kind=='exclusion' and 3 or 1)].rgb
   local path={}
   local copy={points=path,color=line.loboZoneEdge and {.015,.015,.015} or rgb,thickness=line.thickness}
   result[#result+1]=copy
   local function point(w)
    local key=string.format('%.5f:%.5f',w.x,w.z)
    local entry=cache[key]
    if not entry then entry={world=w,points={}};cache[key]=entry;tasks[#tasks+1]=entry end
    local p={0,0,0};path[#path+1]=p
    local lift=line.loboZoneEdge and .035 or .042
    if kind=='exclusion' then lift=lift+.009 end
    entry.points[#entry.points+1]={p=p,lift=lift}
   end
   local previous=nil
   for _,p in ipairs(line.points or {})do
    local w=target.positionToWorld(loboZoneVector(p))
    if previous then
     local distance=math.sqrt((w.x-previous.x)^2+(w.z-previous.z)^2)
     local count=math.max(1,math.ceil(distance/.5))
     for j=1,count do local t=j/count;point(Vector(previous.x+(w.x-previous.x)*t,0,previous.z+(w.z-previous.z)*t))end
    else point(w)end
    previous=w
   end
  end
 end
 local index=1
 local function step()
  if self.isDestroyed() or target.isDestroyed() or target.getVar('LoboZoneGenerationR1')~=generation then return end
  for work=1,8 do
   local item=tasks[index]
   if not item then target.setVectorLines(result);return end
   local w=item.world;local y=floor
   if Physics and Physics.cast then
    local ok,hits=pcall(Physics.cast,{origin={w.x,math.max(50,floor+40),w.z},direction={0,-1,0},type=1,max_distance=100})
    if ok then for _,hit in ipairs(hits or {})do
     if hit.point and terrain(hit.hit_object) then y=math.max(y,hit.point.y)end
    end end
   end
   for _,ref in ipairs(item.points)do
    local p=target.positionToLocal(Vector(w.x,y+ref.lift,w.z))
    ref.p[1],ref.p[2],ref.p[3]=p.x,p.y,p.z
   end
   index=index+1
  end
  Wait.frames(step,1)
 end
 if #tasks==0 then target.setVectorLines(result)else Wait.frames(step,1)end
end
-- END LOBO BRIGHT ZONES R1

local lmr={owner="80bb62"}
function lmr.flipped()
 local o=getObjectFromGUID(lmr.owner)
 return o and o.getVar('LOBO_MAP_ROTATION_FLIPPED')==true
end
function lmr.vector(p)
 return Vector(p.x or p[1] or 0,p.y or p[2] or 0,p.z or p[3] or 0)
end
function lmr.point(p)
 local v=lmr.vector(p)
 if lmr.flipped() then v.x=-v.x;v.z=-v.z end
 return v
end
function lmr.rotation(p)
 local v=lmr.vector(p)
 if lmr.flipped() then v.y=(v.y+180)%360 end
 return v
end
function lmr.getPosition(o) return lmr.point(o.getPosition()) end
function lmr.getRotation(o) return lmr.rotation(o.getRotation()) end
function lmr.setPosition(o,p,...) return o.setPosition(lmr.point(p),...) end
function lmr.setRotation(o,p,...) return o.setRotation(lmr.rotation(p),...) end
function lmr.setPositionSmooth(o,p,...) return o.setPositionSmooth(lmr.point(p),...) end
function lmr.setRotationSmooth(o,p,...) return o.setRotationSmooth(lmr.rotation(p),...) end
function lmr.positionToLocal(o,p) return o.positionToLocal(lmr.point(p)) end
function lmr.positionToWorld(o,p) return lmr.point(o.positionToWorld(p)) end
function lmr.getBounds(o)
 local b=o.getBounds();if b and b.center then b.center=lmr.point(b.center) end;return b
end
function lmr.getTransformForward(o) return lmr.point(o.getTransformForward()) end
function lmr.getTransformRight(o) return lmr.point(o.getTransformRight()) end
function lmr.getTransformUp(o) return lmr.point(o.getTransformUp()) end
function lmr.copy(p) local q={};for k,v in pairs(p)do q[k]=v end;return q end
function lmr.cast(p)
 local q=lmr.copy(p)
 if q.origin then q.origin=lmr.point(q.origin) end
 if q.direction then q.direction=lmr.point(q.direction) end
 if q.orientation then q.orientation=lmr.rotation(q.orientation) end
 local hits=Physics.cast(q)
 for _,hit in ipairs(hits or{})do
  if hit.point then hit.point=lmr.point(hit.point)end
  if hit.normal then hit.normal=lmr.point(hit.normal)end
 end
 return hits
end
function lmr.data(d)
 if not lmr.flipped()then return d end
 local t=d.Transform
 if t then t.posX=-(t.posX or 0);t.posZ=-(t.posZ or 0);t.rotY=((t.rotY or 0)+180)%360 end
 for _,s in pairs(d.States or{})do lmr.data(s)end
 return d
end
function lmr.getData(o) return lmr.data(o.getData()) end
function lmr.getJSON(o,...) return JSON.encode(lmr.data(JSON.decode(o.getJSON(...)))) end
function lmr.spawnObjectJSON(p)
 local q=lmr.copy(p);q.json=JSON.encode(lmr.data(JSON.decode(q.json)))
 if q.position then q.position=lmr.point(q.position)end
 if q.rotation then q.rotation=lmr.rotation(q.rotation)end
 return spawnObjectJSON(q)
end
function lmr.spawnObjectData(p)
 local q=lmr.copy(p);q.data=lmr.data(q.data)
 if q.position then q.position=lmr.point(q.position)end
 if q.rotation then q.rotation=lmr.rotation(q.rotation)end
 return spawnObjectData(q)
end
function lmr.spawnObject(p)
 local q=lmr.copy(p)
 if q.position then q.position=lmr.point(q.position)end
 if q.rotation then q.rotation=lmr.rotation(q.rotation)end
 return spawnObject(q)
end

-- Universal DZ compositor: preserve mission lines while owning deployment visibility.
local function loboUniversalWrite(target,lines)
 if target.getGUID()=="d40309" then
  local owner=getObjectFromGUID("80bb62")
  if owner and not owner.isDestroyed() then
   local ok,handled=pcall(function()return owner.call('loboUniversalSetBase',{guid=target.getGUID(),lines=lines})end)
   if ok and handled then return end
  end
 end
 loboZoneWrite(target,lines)
end
-- BEGIN LOBO CONTRAST DEPLOYMENT LINES V2
-- Every colored centerline remains at its exact measured X/Z coordinates.
local function loboContrastDraw(target,source)
 if not target or target.isDestroyed() then return end
 local strokes={}
 for _,line in ipairs(source or {})do
  if line.points and #line.points>1 then
   local kind=line.kind
   
   loboInk(target,strokes,line.points,kind)
  end
 end
 loboUniversalWrite(target,strokes)
end
-- END LOBO CONTRAST DEPLOYMENT LINES V2


local marker="AzureCoast/Tidal-Infrastructure-R8"
local key="azureCleanupBusy"
function clearAzure()
 if Global.getVar(key) then return end
 Global.setVar(key,true)
 local doomed={}
 for _,o in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
  if o~=self and o.getGMNotes()==marker then table.insert(doomed,o) end
 end
 for _,o in ipairs(doomed) do o.destruct() end
 Global.setVar(key,false)
end
function loboPreviousDestroy() clearAzure() end
function onLoad() self.setLock(true) end

function lmr.positionToWorld(o,p) return lmr.point(o.positionToWorld(p)) end

function lmr.getTransformRight(o) return lmr.point(o.getTransformRight()) end

 if q.position then q.position=lmr.point(q.position)end

 return spawnObjectData(q)
end

end

ContainedObjects.Description:
Aurora VII | current territory rules and owner advantage. Open Map Rules at the top of the screen.

Tidal Channels
All water features are Aquatic Difficult Terrain.

A trooper with Terrain (Aquatic) or Terrain (Total) whose base is entirely inside a water feature gains Total Cover while in that area.

An observer with Terrain (Aquatic) or Terrain (Total) ignores this water-based Total Cover when drawing Line of Sight to the protected trooper.

Troopers with Aerial cannot gain or ignore water-based Total Cover through this territory rule, even if they possess Terrain (Aquatic) or Terrain (Total).

If the protected trooper declares a Skill that would normally break Stealth, it loses this Total Cover for the rest of that Order. After the Order, protection returns if it still qualifies.

Place four Supply Caches outside the Deployment Zones. They function as Panoplies.

OWNER ONLY
Corrosion Protection: Once per game, reroll one failed Saving Roll made by a friendly trooper with STR. Accept the second result.

SCOPE AND TIMING
Rules revision: 30 October 2026. Matches Aurora VII Territory Special Rules revision 2026.10.30.

Territorial games: both players use this battlefield rule and the current Campaign Event. Only a player registered to the controlling Conquest faction receives the owner advantage. Ownership is the recorded controller at the start of the Campaign Turn and stays fixed throughout that Turn. NA2 employment, Tohaa support and CA Infiltration do not transfer the advantage.

Narrative games: territory rules and owner advantages do not apply unless the current Narrative Mission sheet explicitly names them. Use that sheet and the current Event instead.

Apply normal points, SWC, availability and army composition, plus territory exclusions. Before deployment, agree water, trails, clearings, building interiors and other terrain boundaries. The current mission sheet governs deployment and mandatory objective positions. Campaign exceptions override the corresponding baseline only where stated; apply territory and Event rules together. A prohibition overrides an ordinary permission or benefit. Obtain a GM ruling before deployment if effects cannot be reconciled.

Make pre-game selections after the final army is confirmed and before either player deploys. Declare the selection to your opponent; record it privately with the GM instead if identifying the trooper would reveal information protected by the normal rules. Declare once-per-game benefits and rerolls in their stated window. Do not reroll a roll more than once unless a rule expressly allows a further reroll. Selection and usage tracking are reminders, not automated game enforcement.
Mission: six independent reference tabs. Deployment: thin forward boundaries only; no backs or sides.

-- BEGIN LOBO BRIGHT ZONES R1
-- Coordinates and line widths are measured in tabletop inches.
local loboZonePalette={
 {name='Red',rgb={1,0,0},hex='#FF0000FF'},
 {name='Orange',rgb={1,.45,0},hex='#FF7300FF'},
 {name='Yellow',rgb={1,1,0},hex='#FFFF00FF'},
 {name='Green',rgb={0,1,0},hex='#00FF00FF'},
 {name='Blue',rgb={.10,.35,1},hex='#1A59FFFF'},
 {name='Indigo',rgb={.50,.20,1},hex='#8033FFFF'},
 {name='Violet',rgb={.90,.08,1},hex='#E614FFFF'}
}
local function loboZoneIndex(n,default)
 return type(n)=='number' and n==math.floor(n) and n>=1 and n<=7 and n or default
end
local function loboZoneVector(p)return Vector(p.x or p[1],p.y or p[2],p.z or p[3])end
local function loboInk(target,out,points,kind)
 if not target or target.isDestroyed() or #points<2 then return end
 kind=kind or 'deployment'
 local scale=target.getScale();local width=math.max(math.abs(scale.x),math.abs(scale.z),.000001)
 local function stroke(path)
  out[#out+1]={points=path,color={.015,.015,.015},thickness=.15/width,loboZoneKind=kind,loboZoneEdge=true}
  out[#out+1]={points=path,color={1,0,0},thickness=.10/width,loboZoneKind=kind,loboZoneEdge=false}
 end
 if kind~='exclusion' then stroke(points);return end
 local step,length=.50,.12
 local nextDot,distance=step*.5,0
 for i=2,#points do
  local a,b=loboZoneVector(points[i-1]),loboZoneVector(points[i])
  local aw,bw=target.positionToWorld(a),target.positionToWorld(b)
  local span=math.sqrt((bw.x-aw.x)^2+(bw.z-aw.z)^2)
  while span>0 and nextDot<=distance+span do
   local t0=math.max(0,(nextDot-distance-length/2)/span)
   local t1=math.min(1,(nextDot-distance+length/2)/span)
   stroke({{a.x+(b.x-a.x)*t0,a.y+(b.y-a.y)*t0,a.z+(b.z-a.z)*t0},
           {a.x+(b.x-a.x)*t1,a.y+(b.y-a.y)*t1,a.z+(b.z-a.z)*t1}})
   nextDot=nextDot+step
  end
  distance=distance+span
 end
end
-- One generation per MAT, shared by every contributing script. Late jobs cannot
-- restore old guides after Off, another selection, a clear, or a color change.
local function loboZoneWrite(target,source)
 if not target or target.isDestroyed() then return end
 local combined={}
 for _,line in ipairs(source or {})do if not line.loboStandardGuide then combined[#combined+1]=line end end
 for _,line in ipairs(target.getTable('LoboStandardGuides')or{})do combined[#combined+1]=line end
 source=combined
 target.setTable('LoboZoneSourceR1',source or {})
 local generation=(target.getVar('LoboZoneGenerationR1') or 0)+1
 target.setVar('LoboZoneGenerationR1',generation)
 local colors=target.getTable('LoboZoneColorsR1') or {}
 local result,tasks,cache={},{},{}
 local bounds=target.getBounds()
 local floor=bounds.center.y+bounds.size.y/2
 local tags={};for _,tag in ipairs(target.getTags() or {})do if tag:sub(1,8)=='LoboMap:' then tags[tag]=true end end
 local function terrain(o)
  if not o or o.isDestroyed() then return false end
  if o==target then return true end
  if o.hasTag('mission') or o.hasTag('controller') or o.hasTag('LoboBackgroundController') then return false end
  for tag in pairs(tags)do if o.hasTag(tag) then return true end end
  return false
 end
 for _,line in ipairs(source or {})do
  local kind=line.loboZoneKind
  if not kind then result[#result+1]=line
  else
   local rgb=kind=='scoring' and {.92,.94,1} or loboZonePalette[loboZoneIndex(colors[kind],kind=='exclusion' and 3 or 1)].rgb
   local path={}
   local copy={points=path,color=line.loboZoneEdge and {.015,.015,.015} or rgb,thickness=line.thickness}
   result[#result+1]=copy
   local function point(w)
    local key=string.format('%.5f:%.5f',w.x,w.z)
    local entry=cache[key]
    if not entry then entry={world=w,points={}};cache[key]=entry;tasks[#tasks+1]=entry end
    local p={0,0,0};path[#path+1]=p
    local lift=line.loboZoneEdge and .035 or .042
    if kind=='exclusion' then lift=lift+.009 end
    entry.points[#entry.points+1]={p=p,lift=lift}
   end
   local previous=nil
   for _,p in ipairs(line.points or {})do
    local w=target.positionToWorld(loboZoneVector(p))
    if previous then
     local distance=math.sqrt((w.x-previous.x)^2+(w.z-previous.z)^2)
     local count=math.max(1,math.ceil(distance/.5))
     for j=1,count do local t=j/count;point(Vector(previous.x+(w.x-previous.x)*t,0,previous.z+(w.z-previous.z)*t))end
    else point(w)end
    previous=w
   end
  end
 end
 local index=1
 local function step()
  if self.isDestroyed() or target.isDestroyed() or target.getVar('LoboZoneGenerationR1')~=generation then return end
  for work=1,8 do
   local item=tasks[index]
   if not item then target.setVectorLines(result);return end
   local w=item.world;local y=floor
   if Physics and Physics.cast then
    local ok,hits=pcall(Physics.cast,{origin={w.x,math.max(50,floor+40),w.z},direction={0,-1,0},type=1,max_distance=100})
    if ok then for _,hit in ipairs(hits or {})do
     if hit.point and terrain(hit.hit_object) then y=math.max(y,hit.point.y)end
    end end
   end
   for _,ref in ipairs(item.points)do
    local p=target.positionToLocal(Vector(w.x,y+ref.lift,w.z))
    ref.p[1],ref.p[2],ref.p[3]=p.x,p.y,p.z
   end
   index=index+1
  end
  Wait.frames(step,1)
 end
 if #tasks==0 then target.setVectorLines(result)else Wait.frames(step,1)end
end

-- BEGIN LOBO BRIGHT ZONES R1
-- Coordinates and line widths are measured in tabletop inches.
local loboZonePalette={
 {name='Red',rgb={1,0,0},hex='#FF0000FF'},
 {name='Orange',rgb={1,.45,0},hex='#FF7300FF'},
 {name='Yellow',rgb={1,1,0},hex='#FFFF00FF'},
 {name='Green',rgb={0,1,0},hex='#00FF00FF'},
 {name='Blue',rgb={.10,.35,1},hex='#1A59FFFF'},
 {name='Indigo',rgb={.50,.20,1},hex='#8033FFFF'},
 {name='Violet',rgb={.90,.08,1},hex='#E614FFFF'}
}
local function loboZoneIndex(n,default)
 return type(n)=='number' and n==math.floor(n) and n>=1 and n<=7 and n or default
end
local function loboZoneVector(p)return Vector(p.x or p[1],p.y or p[2],p.z or p[3])end
local function loboInk(target,out,points,kind)
 if not target or target.isDestroyed() or #points<2 then return end
 kind=kind or 'deployment'
 local scale=target.getScale();local width=math.max(math.abs(scale.x),math.abs(scale.z),.000001)
 local function stroke(path)
  out[#out+1]={points=path,color={.015,.015,.015},thickness=.15/width,loboZoneKind=kind,loboZoneEdge=true}
  out[#out+1]={points=path,color={1,0,0},thickness=.10/width,loboZoneKind=kind,loboZoneEdge=false}
 end
 if kind~='exclusion' then stroke(points);return end
 local step,length=.50,.12
 local nextDot,distance=step*.5,0
 for i=2,#points do
  local a,b=loboZoneVector(points[i-1]),loboZoneVector(points[i])
  local aw,bw=target.positionToWorld(a),target.positionToWorld(b)
  local span=math.sqrt((bw.x-aw.x)^2+(bw.z-aw.z)^2)
  while span>0 and nextDot<=distance+span do
   local t0=math.max(0,(nextDot-distance-length/2)/span)
   local t1=math.min(1,(nextDot-distance+length/2)/span)
   stroke({{a.x+(b.x-a.x)*t0,a.y+(b.y-a.y)*t0,a.z+(b.z-a.z)*t0},
           {a.x+(b.x-a.x)*t1,a.y+(b.y-a.y)*t1,a.z+(b.z-a.z)*t1}})
   nextDot=nextDot+step
  end
  distance=distance+span
 end
end
-- One generation per MAT, shared by every contributing script. Late jobs cannot
-- restore old guides after Off, another selection, a clear, or a color change.
local function loboZoneWrite(target,source)
 if not target or target.isDestroyed() then return end
 local combined={}
 for _,line in ipairs(source or {})do if not line.loboStandardGuide then combined[#combined+1]=line end end
 for _,line in ipairs(target.getTable('LoboStandardGuides')or{})do combined[#combined+1]=line end
 source=combined
 target.setTable('LoboZoneSourceR1',source or {})
 local generation=(target.getVar('LoboZoneGenerationR1') or 0)+1
 target.setVar('LoboZoneGenerationR1',generation)
 local colors=target.getTable('LoboZoneColorsR1') or {}
 local result,tasks,cache={},{},{}
 local bounds=target.getBounds()
 local floor=bounds.center.y+bounds.size.y/2
 local tags={};for _,tag in ipairs(target.getTags() or {})do if tag:sub(1,8)=='LoboMap:' then tags[tag]=true end end
 local function terrain(o)
  if not o or o.isDestroyed() then return false end
  if o==target then return true end
  if o.hasTag('mission') or o.hasTag('controller') or o.hasTag('LoboBackgroundController') then return false end
  for tag in pairs(tags)do if o.hasTag(tag) then return true end end
  return false
 end
 for _,line in ipairs(source or {})do
  local kind=line.loboZoneKind
  if not kind then result[#result+1]=line
  else
   local rgb=kind=='scoring' and {.92,.94,1} or loboZonePalette[loboZoneIndex(colors[kind],kind=='exclusion' and 3 or 1)].rgb
   local path={}
   local copy={points=path,color=line.loboZoneEdge and {.015,.015,.015} or rgb,thickness=line.thickness}
   result[#result+1]=copy
   local function point(w)
    local key=string.format('%.5f:%.5f',w.x,w.z)
    local entry=cache[key]
    if not entry then entry={world=w,points={}};cache[key]=entry;tasks[#tasks+1]=entry end
    local p={0,0,0};path[#path+1]=p
    local lift=line.loboZoneEdge and .035 or .042
    if kind=='exclusion' then lift=lift+.009 end
    entry.points[#entry.points+1]={p=p,lift=lift}
   end
   local previous=nil
   for _,p in ipairs(line.points or {})do
    local w=target.positionToWorld(loboZoneVector(p))
    if previous then
     local distance=math.sqrt((w.x-previous.x)^2+(w.z-previous.z)^2)
     local count=math.max(1,math.ceil(distance/.5))
     for j=1,count do local t=j/count;point(Vector(previous.x+(w.x-previous.x)*t,0,previous.z+(w.z-previous.z)*t))end
    else point(w)end
    previous=w
   end
  end
 end
 local index=1
 local function step()
  if self.isDestroyed() or target.isDestroyed() or target.getVar('LoboZoneGenerationR1')~=generation then return end
  for work=1,8 do
   local item=tasks[index]
   if not item then target.setVectorLines(result);return end
   local w=item.world;local y=floor
   if Physics and Physics.cast then
    local ok,hits=pcall(Physics.cast,{origin={w.x,math.max(50,floor+40),w.z},direction={0,-1,0},type=1,max_distance=100})
    if ok then for _,hit in ipairs(hits or {})do
     if hit.point and terrain(hit.hit_object) then y=math.max(y,hit.point.y)end
    end end
   end
   for _,ref in ipairs(item.points)do
    local p=target.positionToLocal(Vector(w.x,y+ref.lift,w.z))
    ref.p[1],ref.p[2],ref.p[3]=p.x,p.y,p.z
   end
   index=index+1
  end
  Wait.frames(step,1)
 end
 if #tasks==0 then target.setVectorLines(result)else Wait.frames(step,1)end
end
-- END LOBO BRIGHT ZONES R1

local lmr={owner="80bb62"}
function lmr.flipped()
 local o=getObjectFromGUID(lmr.owner)
 return o and o.getVar('LOBO_MAP_ROTATION_FLIPPED')==true
end
function lmr.vector(p)
 return Vector(p.x or p[1] or 0,p.y or p[2] or 0,p.z or p[3] or 0)
end
function lmr.point(p)
 local v=lmr.vector(p)
 if lmr.flipped() then v.x=-v.x;v.z=-v.z end
 return v
end
function lmr.rotation(p)
 local v=lmr.vector(p)
 if lmr.flipped() then v.y=(v.y+180)%360 end
 return v
end
function lmr.getPosition(o) return lmr.point(o.getPosition()) end
function lmr.getRotation(o) return lmr.rotation(o.getRotation()) end
function lmr.setPosition(o,p,...) return o.setPosition(lmr.point(p),...) end

function lmr.setPositionSmooth(o,p,...) return o.setPositionSmooth(lmr.point(p),...) end
function lmr.setRotationSmooth(o,p,...) return o.setRotationSmooth(lmr.rotation(p),...) end
function lmr.positionToLocal(o,p) return o.positionToLocal(lmr.point(p)) end
function lmr.positionToWorld(o,p) return lmr.point(o.positionToWorld(p)) end
function lmr.getBounds(o)
 local b=o.getBounds();if b and b.center then b.center=lmr.point(b.center) end;return b
end

  end
  UI.setXmlTable(roots)
 end
 function loboStandardMissionOpen(player)if player then missionReaders[player.color]=true;missionPanel()end end
 function loboStandardMissionClose(player)if player then missionReaders[player.color]=nil;missionPanel()end end
 local function mount()
  if not deployed()or not loboLifeToken or not loboLifeAlive()then return end
  local roots=UI.getXmlTable()or{}
  local id='loboMission_'..self.getGUID()..'_standard'
  for _,n in ipairs(roots)do if n.attributes and n.attributes.id==id then return end end
  local children={}
  for _,item in ipairs({{'mission','Mission','loboStandardMissionOpen'},{'rotate','Turn 180','loboRotateMap180'},{'grid','Grid','loboStandardGrid'},
   {'scoring','Quadrants','loboStandardScoring'},{'clear','Clear Table','loboStandardClear'}})do
   children[#children+1]={tag='Button',attributes={id=id..'_'..item[1],text=item[2],onClick=self.getGUID()..'/'..item[3],width='326',height='34'}}
  end
  roots[#roots+1]={tag='Panel',attributes={id=id},children=children}
  UI.setXmlTable(roots)
 end
 function onLoad(saved)
  LOBO_MAP_ROTATION_FLIPPED=false
  if saved and saved~=''then
   local ok,state=pcall(JSON.decode,saved)
   if ok and type(state)=='table'and state.__loboStandard==1 then
    grid=state.grid==true;scoring=state.scoring==true
    LOBO_MAP_ROTATION_FLIPPED=state.flipped==true;saved=state.original or''
   end
  end
  -- Recover old two-map rotation envelopes nested inside color saves.
  local function unwrapRotation(text)
   if type(text)~='string'or text==''then return text end
   local ok,state=pcall(JSON.decode,text)
   if not ok or type(state)~='table'then return text end
   if state.__loboMapRotation==1 then
    LOBO_MAP_ROTATION_FLIPPED=state.flipped==true;return unwrapRotation(state.original or'')
   end
   if type(state.original)=='string'then state.original=unwrapRotation(state.original);return JSON.encode(state)end
   return text
  end
  if oldLoad then oldLoad(unwrapRotation(saved))end
  Wait.condition(function()if Grid then Grid.show_lines=grid end;drawGuides();mount();notify()end,
   function()return deployed()and loboLifeToken~=nil end,60)
  Wait.time(mount,1,-1)
 end
 function onSave()
  if busy then restoreLocks()end
  return JSON.encode({__loboStandard=1,flipped=LOBO_MAP_ROTATION_FLIPPED,grid=Grid and Grid.show_lines==true,scoring=scoring,original=oldSave and oldSave()or''})
 end
 function onDestroy()
  if busy then restoreLocks()end
  if oldDestroy then oldDestroy()end
 end
end
